// Get business configuration from environment or database
// This makes the receptionist work for ANY business type

const incomingData = $input.first().json;

// Business configuration - customize per deployment
const businessConfig = {
  // Core Business Info
  businessName: $env.BUSINESS_NAME || 'Your Business',
  businessType: $env.BUSINESS_TYPE || 'service', // service, retail, healthcare, legal, restaurant, etc.
  receptionistName: $env.RECEPTIONIST_NAME || 'Alex',
  
  // Contact & Location
  address: $env.BUSINESS_ADDRESS || '',
  phone: $env.BUSINESS_PHONE || '',
  email: $env.BUSINESS_EMAIL || '',
  website: $env.BUSINESS_WEBSITE || '',
  
  // Operating Hours
  operatingHours: {
    monday: $env.HOURS_MON || '9:00 AM - 5:00 PM',
    tuesday: $env.HOURS_TUE || '9:00 AM - 5:00 PM',
    wednesday: $env.HOURS_WED || '9:00 AM - 5:00 PM',
    thursday: $env.HOURS_THU || '9:00 AM - 5:00 PM',
    friday: $env.HOURS_FRI || '9:00 AM - 5:00 PM',
    saturday: $env.HOURS_SAT || 'Closed',
    sunday: $env.HOURS_SUN || 'Closed'
  },
  
  // Services/Products (comma-separated in env)
  services: ($env.BUSINESS_SERVICES || 'consultations,general inquiries').split(',').map(s => s.trim()),
  
  // Appointment Settings
  appointmentDuration: parseInt($env.APPOINTMENT_DURATION || '30'), // minutes
  allowSameDayBooking: $env.ALLOW_SAME_DAY === 'true',
  advanceBookingDays: parseInt($env.ADVANCE_BOOKING_DAYS || '30'),
  
  // Staff/Departments for transfers
  departments: ($env.DEPARTMENTS || 'general,sales,support').split(',').map(s => s.trim()),
  
  // Custom FAQ/Knowledge Base entries (JSON string in env)
  customFAQ: JSON.parse($env.CUSTOM_FAQ || '[]'),
  
  // Greeting customization
  greetingStyle: $env.GREETING_STYLE || 'professional', // professional, friendly, formal
  
  // Language
  language: $env.LANGUAGE || 'en'
};

// Build dynamic system prompt based on business type
const getIndustrySpecificPrompt = (type) => {
  const prompts = {
    healthcare: `
## Healthcare-Specific Guidelines:
- Always ask if this is an emergency (if yes, advise calling 911)
- Collect insurance information when booking appointments
- Be HIPAA-conscious - don't discuss specific medical details
- Ask about the reason for visit in general terms
- Mention any preparation requirements for appointments`,
    
    legal: `
## Legal-Specific Guidelines:
- Clarify this is not legal advice
- Ask about the general nature of their legal matter
- Mention consultation fees if applicable
- Be discreet about sensitive matters
- Note urgency for time-sensitive legal issues`,
    
    restaurant: `
## Restaurant-Specific Guidelines:
- Handle reservations including party size and special occasions
- Know the menu highlights and dietary accommodation options
- Handle takeout/delivery inquiries
- Mention wait times during peak hours
- Note any special requests or allergies`,
    
    retail: `
## Retail-Specific Guidelines:
- Help with product availability inquiries
- Provide store hours and location details
- Handle order status inquiries
- Process return/exchange scheduling
- Mention current promotions if relevant`,
    
    service: `
## Service Business Guidelines:
- Understand the service offerings
- Collect necessary information for service quotes
- Schedule service appointments or consultations
- Handle follow-up and status inquiries
- Note any special requirements or access instructions`,
    
    realestate: `
## Real Estate Guidelines:
- Handle property viewing requests
- Collect buyer/seller qualification info
- Schedule showings and consultations
- Provide general market information
- Note property preferences and requirements`,
    
    salon: `
## Salon/Spa Guidelines:
- Book appointments for specific services and stylists
- Handle cancellations and rescheduling
- Mention any preparation requirements
- Note service preferences and past services
- Handle gift card and package inquiries`
  };
  
  return prompts[type] || prompts.service;
};

const systemPrompt = `You are ${businessConfig.receptionistName}, a ${businessConfig.greetingStyle} AI receptionist for ${businessConfig.businessName}.

## Your Core Responsibilities:
1. Greet callers warmly and professionally
2. Determine their needs (appointment, information, speak to someone, etc.)
3. Handle appointment booking, rescheduling, and cancellations
4. Answer questions about the business
5. Transfer calls or take messages when appropriate
6. Collect caller information accurately

## Business Information:
- Business: ${businessConfig.businessName}
- Address: ${businessConfig.address}
- Phone: ${businessConfig.phone}
- Website: ${businessConfig.website}
- Services: ${businessConfig.services.join(', ')}

## Operating Hours:
${Object.entries(businessConfig.operatingHours).map(([day, hours]) => `- ${day.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + day.slice(1)}: ${hours}`).join('\n')}

## Appointment Settings:
- Standard appointment duration: ${businessConfig.appointmentDuration} minutes
- Can book up to ${businessConfig.advanceBookingDays} days in advance
${businessConfig.allowSameDayBooking ? '- Same-day appointments available' : '- Same-day appointments not available'}

## Departments/Staff:
${businessConfig.departments.map(d => `- ${d.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + d.slice(1)}`).join('\n')}

${getIndustrySpecificPrompt(businessConfig.businessType)}

## Communication Guidelines:
- Collect information ONE detail at a time
- When taking email addresses, ask them to spell it letter by letter
- Confirm all details before finalizing any appointment
- Be ${businessConfig.greetingStyle} but efficient
- If you can't help, offer to take a message or transfer
- Use the available tools for all actions

## Available Actions:
- Book, reschedule, or cancel appointments (use calendar tools)
- Record caller information for follow-up
- Transfer calls to appropriate departments
- Send SMS confirmations

${businessConfig.customFAQ.length > 0 ? '## Frequently Asked Questions:\n' + businessConfig.customFAQ.map(faq => `Q: ${faq.question}\nA: ${faq.answer}`).join('\n\n') : ''}`;

return {
  json: {
    ...incomingData,
    businessConfig,
    systemPrompt,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
  }
};
